answer_1.quote: By converting natural language (NL) questions into executable forms (i.e., Structured Query Language or SQL), text-to-SQL parsers relieve users from the burden of learning about techniques behind the queries.

answer_2.quote: We report the results achieved by five base parsers. For the WikiSQL dataset, we report the accuracy of SQL exact matching (SQLAcc) and the accuracy of execution (ExeAcc). ... We only report the results of SQLAcc ...

answer_4.guideline: Volunteers interact with the PIIA agent by answering multi‑choice questions; the resulting SQL queries are compared against ground‑truth SQL to compute SQL accuracy.
